concerns.text: The plan cites the VLA dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/tencent/Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA-Data) as the primary source of egocentric video segments. ACE‑Ego‑0’s pseudo‑action reliability scores are defined on a specific proprietary dataset; substituting VLA, which has a different collection protocol and no native reliability labels, may not faithfully reproduce the original ACE‑Ego‑0 variance analysis. This constitutes a wrong‑dataset choice for the research question.

Phase 3 task T3‑01 proposes computing optical‑flow statistics for 1 s, 3 s, 5 s, 10 s windows using CPU‑only `torchvision`, and Phase 1 task T1‑03 runs a YOLOv8 hand detector on every frame. Processing up to 5 000 episodes (~10 h video) at 1 fps on the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, ~7 GB RAM) is unlikely to complete within the claimed ≤ 5 h wall‑clock budget and may exceed the 6 GB RAM limit, making the pipeline infeasible under the free‑compute constraints.
